uptime_commitment_pct.quote: | Build, Submit, Update and Workflows | 99.9% monthly uptime |

timezone.missing_reason: The source does not state a time zone for measuring the month.

value.description: Downtime is the total number of minutes during which a service is unavailable excluding outages caused by factors outside of our control, including, but not limited to, third-party vendors or other external impacts. A minute is unavailable if all requests throughout that minute return a 5xx HTTP error status or do not return a response.

downtime_definition.quote: A minute is considered unavailable if all requests throughout that minute return a 5xx HTTP error status (5XX) or do not return a response.

credit_tiers.quote: | < 99.9% | 10% of the cost of your Enterprise plan for the affected month | […] | < 99% | 25% of the cost of your Enterprise plan for the affected month |

credit_basis.quote: Service credit is the percentage of your applicable monthly service fee that is credited to you for uptime below our listed service levels.

credit_cap.quote: Total monthly service credits granted to a maximum of 30% the cost of the Enterprise Support Add-on for the affected month.
credit_cap.missing_reason: The cap applies only to the Enterprise Support Add-on response credits, not to uptime credits for EAS services; no cap stated for uptime credits.

min_credit.missing_reason: The source contains no minimum credit amount or threshold.

value.description: Outages caused by factors outside of our control, including but not limited to third-party vendors or other external impacts, are excluded from Downtime.

claim_procedure.quote: Claims for service credit need to be made in writing through our [contact page](/contact) and within 30 days of the incident and must include all necessary information for us to validate the claim. Information we'll need might include a detailed description of the incident, date, time, logs, etc.

remedy_form.quote: Credits are applied to future service fees, are applied within 60 days from request, and are your sole and exclusive remedy for any performance or availability issues for any service under this agreement and this SLA.
